title: How a P-Trap Seals Out Sewer Gas
description: A fixture P-trap is a critical component of sink drainage designed to hold a small amount of water after every use. This trapped water forms an airtight liquid seal within the pipe dip, blocking dangerous and foul-smelling sewer gases from escaping into living spaces. Gravity allows wastewater to push through the trap, while atmospheric pressure maintained by the vent line prevents siphonage from pulling the water seal out. Clean, well-proportioned P-trap installations ensure both proper drainage flow and reliable gas protection.

How a P-Trap Seals Out Sewer Gas

A fixture P-trap is a critical component of sink drainage designed to hold a small amount of water after every use. This trapped water forms an airtight liquid seal within the pipe dip, blocking dangerous and foul-smelling sewer gases from escaping into living spaces. Gravity allows wastewater to push through the trap, while atmospheric pressure maintained by the vent line prevents siphonage from pulling the water seal out. Clean, well-proportioned P-trap installations ensure both proper drainage flow and reliable gas protection.
